findings.summary: crates/athena-gate/src/landing_tests.rs is not among the reading's deliverables
findings.evidence: A change outside the listed deliverables widens the scope.

findings.summary: The criterion-1 test overstates the merge-off case: the drain still counts an open pull request with green checks as a failure.
findings.evidence: drain.rs:2607-2613 turns any report that is not Landed into NotLanded, and drain.rs:1537-1539 counts it as a failure and stops after ATTEMPTS. The project runs with merge_via_rest = true (athena.toml:189), so the real path is covered. Fix: Drop the 'nothing failed' claim for merge-off. State in the CHANGELOG and decision entry that 'waiting, never failed' holds only when the drain merges.

findings.summary: The required-check judgment should pick the latest run of the required name with the existing parse_check_run.
findings.evidence: client.rs:119-136 parse_check_run already picks the highest-id run of a name. The plan does not say which run is used when the reply lists more than one. Fix: Build on parse_check_run(runs, CI_AGGREGATE_JOB): None or unfinished means Pending, failed means Red, success or skipped means Green. Add a unit case with an older failed run and a newer successful one that reads Green.

findings.summary: The head check and the check on main now treat held records differently; state it, and test the head check itself.
findings.evidence: landing() (invariant.rs:369-381) still uses closing_jobs, which keeps jobs with no outcome so the check on main refuses them, while classify_pre_merge (history.rs:153, land.rs:169) will drop held jobs. Dropping them before the SeveralJobs count also turns a commit with one held job and one landing job into a JobLanding. Fix: Document both differences in invariant.rs and the decision entry. Optionally add one history_of test on a pull request head with a held-job commit, showing no violation.

summary: I checked the plan against the snapshot using Read and Grep only. The fault starts where the plan says: classify_checks (client.rs:766-794) marks any failed run or status as Red, and classify_pre_merge (invariant.rs:311-328) returns NoVerification for any closing job without a verification record. CI_AGGREGATE_JOB (client.rs:516) exists, and early.rs:25 repeats its literal, so pointing EARLY_RUN_JOB at it removes the duplicate. disk.rs:15-22 says held jobs commit candidate, invocations and plans with no outcome, so the held-job rule reads the commit's own records. merge_via_rest is true in athena.toml:189. The tests use real seams (land_pr over the real GhClient with a scripted transport; classify_pre_merge over a real temporary git repository) and would fail without the change. Three minor issues: the merge-off claim in the criterion-1 test, picking the latest run of the required name, and documenting or testing that the head check and the check on main now treat held records differently.
